source: OpenSubtitles (OPUS) zh subtitles converted to simplified
license: LCCC-base MIT; OpenSubtitles per OPUS terms (user accepted 2026-10-10)
build: tools/ime_lab/ngram/continuation_build.cc (two passes) over the segmented corpus of the T9 word model (ngram_build --segment): context = trailing 1-2 characters of committed text, continuation = next Han word or rest of the current word; --contexts 40000 --top 10 --min-total 80 --min-count 3 --max-context 2
score: count/total = P(continuation | context); mixed 0.7 base + 0.15 neural model + 0.15 personal in NgramFusionEngine
purpose: post-commit word association baseline, not a pinyin decoder or personal history
validation: tools/ime_lab/ngram/suggest_eval.py on API-generated chat sentences (test only): top-3 continuation hit 18.4% -> 38.1% (chat-fn, 235 sentences), 17.1% -> 41.7% (everyday, 171); after common single characters 11.7% -> 21.2%; 这 1/53 -> 18/53

word_completions.lexicon: jieba 0.42.1 dict.txt, MIT (https://github.com/fxsjy/jieba); words of 2+ characters
word_completions.rule: row marked when a suffix of the context plus a prefix of the continuation is a lexicon word (莫+名 -> 莫名); used only after a commit ending in 2+ Han characters, see BaseAssociationModel.predict(afterWholeWord)
